high_level_description: The image features two individuals standing close together against a backdrop with the SiriusXM logo prominently displayed. The person on the left appears to be a woman with blonde hair styled in an updo, wearing a dark blue top with white polka dots. She is smiling warmly and has her hand placed on the shoulder of the person next to her. The individual on the right is a man with short, light brown hair, dressed in a light gray suit jacket over a light blue shirt. He is also smiling and has his arm around the woman's shoulder.
